item.title: A surprising number of Americans use AI for spiritual reasons. Here's what they told us
item.description: While most people who use artificial intelligence do so for productivity help, a small but devoted group is turning to AI for religious and spiritual reasons.
item.content:encoded: While most people who use artificial intelligence do so for productivity help, a small but devoted group is turning to AI for religious and spiritual reasons.

item.title: Pope Leo warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity on his France visit
item.description: Pope Leo XIV raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech on his first papal visit to France.

item.title: Catholic media star Archbishop Fulton Sheen beatified
item.description: The Catholic Bishop of Rochester, New York, Fulton Sheen, moves one step closer to sainthood with his beatification. Sheen is best known for hosting radio and television programs for over four decades.

item.title: Here's what's on the docket for Pope Leo XIV's first papal visit to France since 2008
item.description: In the first papal state visit to France in nearly 20 years, Pope Leo will preside over Mass in Paris, meet with sex abuse survivors and deliver a speech on European unity.

item.title: Conflicts over Israel divide some American Jews for Yom Kippur
item.description: For many Jews, Yom Kippur is one of the holiest days of the year. But as internal conflicts over Israel divide some American Jews, some are staying away from synagogues and family gatherings.

item.title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.
